purpose: Prove that the existing explicit Google Drive base-skin PNG source family is directly readable, byte-identical to the frozen five-Hero sample manifest, visually clean, and suitable as the representative canonical PNG source candidate before any population-wide expansion.

proofSet.selectionReason: All five already have explicit Drive file IDs, source hashes, dimensions, alpha policy, and clean-character-art provenance in the frozen sample manifest.

sourceAdmissionRules: Use only a frozen explicit Drive file ID or a separately proven explicit Hero ID to source mapping.
Generic Hero-name or filename-similarity search is not authoritative and cannot admit a source file.
Drive readback MIME type must be image/png.
Live byte length, SHA-256, dimensions, and alpha properties must match frozen evidence when frozen evidence exists.
The image must contain the intended Hero's clean character artwork with transparency and without baked rarity, SP, faction-buff, or other UI decoration.
Base-skin admission requires provenance consistent with GOOGLE_DRIVE_BASE_SKIN_PNG; SkinNN or otherwise ambiguous variants are not admitted by inference.

representativeOutputRule.note: Stage 2 proves source suitability only. The population-wide deterministic extraction/materialization contract remains Stage 3 work.

completionCondition: All five proof-set source PNGs are directly readable by explicit Drive ID and pass byte identity, PNG decode, dimensions, RGBA/alpha, Hero identity, base-skin provenance, and decoration-contamination checks with zero hard errors.
